industry.name: Oil & Gas Related Equipment and Services

profile.description: Arabian Drilling Company operates as an onshore and offshore gas and oil rig drilling company in Saudi Arabia. The company’s services include the supply of drilling services in shallow and deep waters and on land for the exploration and production of oil and natural gas, as well as well intervention and testing, rig move, mobilisation, manpower, and other services. Arabian Drilling Company was founded in 1964 and is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia.

finsights.brief: Net income is expected to grow this year
Short term obligations exceed liquid assets

summary: Q3 revenue rose 6% to 812M riyals; EBITDA jumped 27.5% to 319M with margin expanding to 39.4% from 32.8% as offshore operations resumed.
Net income returned to 31M riyal profit vs 32M loss in Q2, though EPS of 0.2505 missed forecast by 26.1%; stock gained 2.55% to $100.5.
Record backlog reached 17.6B riyals, up 60% YoY; Q4 revenue guidance set at 876-892M riyals, reflecting 8-10% sequential growth.
Full-year 2026 CapEx raised to 750-800M riyals to accelerate rig reactivation; fleet utilization expected to reach 90% by Q4 end.
Net debt increased 9.3% to 2.6B riyals while cash fell to 327M; management expects stable day rates through 2027 with optimistic outlook.
